no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Per the FY2025 10-K (filed March 2026), all four wholly-owned Korro programs (KRRO-121 hyperammonemia, next-gen GalNAc AATD, AMPK-gamma1 longevity/liver, ALS TDP-43) remain in research or preclinical stage. The company explicitly states all programs are in research or preclinical. The only program that had reached the clinic, KRRO-110 (LNP-based AATD, NCT06677307 Phase 1/2a), was TERMINATED in 2025 after a strategic pivot to GalNAc-conjugated delivery. KRRO-121 first-in-human filing is anticipated H2 2026; AATD development candidate nomination expected Q2 2026. The Novo Nordisk partnership entered a 12-month pause in November 2025.
excluded_preclinical: KRRO-121 hyperammonemia (UCD/HE) — preclinical; first-in-human filing expected H2 2026
Next-generation GalNAc AATD — preclinical; development candidate nomination expected Q2 2026
Longevity / liver health AMPK-gamma1 GalNAc program — preclinical
Up to two Novo Nordisk-partnered programs — paused Nov 2025
excluded_legacy_terminated: KRRO-110 AATD Phase 1/2a NCT06677307 — TERMINATED 2025; LNP approach abandoned in favor of GalNAc next-generation candidate
